title: Supported-source normalization of the ordinary coefficient unit
statement:
theorem diagonalTrace_supportedUnit_normalization
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (Y : Scheme.{u})
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l (ProjectiveLine Y)]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l (diagonalSurface Y)]
    (f : diagonalSurface Y ⟶ ProjectiveLine Y)
    (p : Presentation l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) f)
    (a : SupportedSource l Y f p.Rc) :
    a.iso.hom = completedPushUnit l f ≫
      (diagonalTracePush l f).map (completedSupportedUnit l Y)

source.place: paragraph (2), finite direct image; geometric classes proof (3), coefficient-unit normalization

proof.text: Postcompose with the inverse supported-source isomorphism. Its normalization identifies the underlying additive map with lowerStarComp, congruence along diagonal followed by f equals identity, and lowerStarId.

The two actual ringed-site unit maps compose as pullback of a local section along f and the diagonal. The ordinary comparisons return this to the same section. Cancel the isomorphism and apply faithfulness of forgetting module structure.
